parsed.explanation: Permissive legal environment with no traveller-facing restriction: expression lawful, foreign documents and X markers accepted, no facility or ward ban, anti-discrimination in goods and services nationwide since 2017, hate-speech and aggravating-factor law, police bias-conduct duty, and a documented detention framework with gender self-determination. Documented positives: 65% public support for marriage equality, open trans military service, medical-body endorsement of puberty blockers, a conversion-therapy association banned. The negatives are real but mostly not trans-specific: a 2025 neo-Nazi dating-app ambush network with 17+ victims (described as gay/bisexual men; trans inclusion unresolved, and police arrested 15 — enforcement, not impunity), raw hate-crime counts with no per-capita or trans breakdown, and a far-right election win. These are climate signals and open questions, not established exposures; they keep it below the 0.85 tier rather than pushing it lower.
